svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Tour Vibes architecture
svg.desc: Tour Vibes architecture. 11 components in 3 groups. Connections: React 19 SPA to Rate limit (Bearer JWT); Rate limit to JWT auth; JWT auth to Multer upload; Multer upload to Validation; Validation to Controllers; Controllers to MongoDB (Mongoose); Multer upload to server/images (writes file); Controllers to server/images (deletes files); React 19 SPA to server/images (GET /images/*); React 19 SPA to Map tiles (Leaflet); React 19 SPA to Nominatim (Find city); React 19 SPA to Mock API (demo build).

text.tspan: Middleware runs in one fixed order before the controllers; the GitHub Pages demo build answers the same calls inside the browser
